scientific_limitations: Inverse classification assumes a loopless strongly connected directed graph and strictly positive incoming weights constant by recipient.
General non-strongly connected and arbitrary edge-dependent weights are not classified.
All exact finite checks corroborate the proof only; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
Historical priority beyond inspected accessible sources and searched records remains subject to independent verification.
title: Exact weight calibration of Shapley stability in directed trust games
